Title: Emerging Issue: WA-WebSites:FUNCTIONS [2505050040010030] [Vancouver Airport Authority] [All functions started fail for execution after host version changed from 4.1038.400.3 to 4.1039.400.1]
Content:
# Emerging Issue Analysis

*Generated on: 2025-05-16 23:45:18 UTC*

## Condition

All Azure Functions executions start failing after the host version is upgraded from 4.1038.400.3 to 4.1039.400.1, specifically for Python 3.11 apps using SQL bindings, with errors referencing a missing method in MoreLinq (e.g., 'Method not found: System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable`1<...> MoreLinq.MoreEnumerable.Batch(...)').

## Diagnostic Query

```kusto
FunctionsLogs\n| where PreciseTimeStamp >= ago(24h)\n| where ExceptionMessage == "Method not found: 'System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable`1<System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable`1<!!0>> MoreLinq.MoreEnumerable.Batch(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable`1<!!0>, Int32)'."\n| where AppName == "yvr-eaa-opsflow-persist-func-prod"
```

## Estimated Time for Action/Resolution

Hotfix rollout completed to all affected stages as of 2025-05-13; issue resolved.

## Internal Mitigation Steps

Prepare and deploy a hotfix to address the MoreLinq version incompatibility in the extension bundle. Until hotfix is applied, instruct customers to pin the extension bundle version to 4.22.0 in host.json: \n\n"extensionBundle": { "id": "Microsoft.Azure.Functions.ExtensionBundle", "version": "[4.22.0]" }\n\nNo host downgrade or change is required. After hotfix deployment, confirm customers can remove the pin and use the latest versions.

## Customer Mitigation Steps

As an immediate workaround, update host.json to pin the extension bundle to version 4.22.0: \n\n"extensionBundle": { "id": "Microsoft.Azure.Functions.ExtensionBundle", "version": "[4.22.0]" }\n\nNo need to downgrade the host version. After the hotfix is applied in your region, you may remove the pin and use the latest extension bundle and host versions.

## Root Cause Analysis

A recent update to the extension bundle (4.23.0) introduced a breaking change by updating the MoreLinq dependency to a version with incompatible method signatures. This caused SQL binding operations to fail with a 'Method not found' exception in all affected Azure Functions after the host version upgrade. The issue was mitigated by pinning the extension bundle to 4.22.0 and later resolved by a hotfix that addressed the dependency incompatibility.
